evidence.detail: The first gated reload path resets the ItemDefinition backing loader/cache state, clears the ItemDefinition cache, invokes the client definition reset path, clears three shared sprite/model caches, refreshes the client and reloads associated definition-backed resources before returning true.

The second gated path clears NpcDefinition model/cache state, rebuilds the 20-entry definition cache array, re-resolves every live NPC's NpcDefinition by id and copies the refreshed size/animation/movement fields back onto the live NPC instances.

The main Client loop invokes both static reload methods after shortcut/command handling; if either performs work the client displays 'Loading - please wait.', sleeps briefly and returns early from that cycle.

The live client-command dispatcher rs/n/a sets the two rs/h/f request flags, including an explicit 'reset' branch for the item-definition reload path, so reload work is deferred from command parsing into the client loop.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the deferred ItemDefinition/NpcDefinition hot-reload coordinator. It is distinct from the callback interfaces/managers sharing package rs/h.
